neighborhood.symmetric_offsets: [-8,+8] inclusive, clipped only at signal boundaries
neighborhood.rationale: smallest symmetric neighborhood containing the unchanged detector's complete pre_avg=8/post_avg=9 adaptive-threshold slice

detector.raw_envelope: librosa.onset.onset_strength with y=unchanged JGA normalized mono Bass, sr=44100, hop_length=512, all other defaults
detector.detection_normalization: subtract global envelope minimum then divide by global maximum plus librosa.util.tiny

quantities: local maximum and earliest tied argmax
adaptive mean, threshold, margin and condition
primary_mechanism_precedence: A_LOCAL_PEAK_RELOCATION: dominant argmax changes and an opposite-condition detected coordinate exists within +/-8 frames
B_WAIT_RANK_COMPETITION: pre-wait eligibility holds in both conditions and wait clearance toggles
E_OTHER_DETECTOR_NATIVE: detection membership changes but prior conditions do not classify it

descriptive_rules.rank: 1 plus count of strictly greater normalized values in the 17-frame neighborhood
descriptive_rules.statistics: count, minimum, median, maximum, arithmetic mean, population SD

diagnostic_plot_selection: Select the lowest sample coordinate in every observed primary transition mechanism and in B, C2, E-before, and E-after; deduplicate by coordinate in sorted selection-class order. Fixed styling and metadata; no manual selection.

prospective_principle_gate.YES: at least 75% of both disappearing and newly observable coordinates receive a detector-native A-E explanation and one primary mechanism accounts for at least 40% of their combined population
prospective_principle_gate.NO: less than 50% of each transition population receives an A-E explanation
prospective_principle_gate.principle_if_yes: Prospectively test transition robustness using detector-native local-maximality, adaptive-threshold margin, and neighborhood peak persistence across an input-only perturbation ensemble, without original-stem Ground Truth or a closest-to-authority rule.

serialization.json: canonical ASCII sorted-key compact JSON, no NaN, one LF
serialization.png: matplotlib Agg 7.2x3.6 inches at 120 dpi, fixed colors/style/metadata
